integrity: The source date and MSC are taken from the first arXiv version and its full text. The proof is reconstructed independently from the definitions. Same-model review assessed correctness, originality, and value; no independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification is only for finite connected simple graphs with upper median degree exactly two; it does not classify equality in other median layers. Exhaustive computation through order six is a stress test, while the universal conclusion rests on the analytic structural proof.
title: Equality at upper median degree two
